label: Bible Study
prompt: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the _____, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verse: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
note: Jesus read this passage aloud in the Nazareth synagogue, then said it was fulfilled that day.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the _____.
verse: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
note: Meek isn't weak — Jesus promises the gentle the whole earth, echoing Psalm 37:11 from His mountainside sermon.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small _____ lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
verse: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
note: No sun, no stars, many days of tempest — just before Paul stood up and told everyone to be of good cheer.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Remove not the ancient _____, which thy fathers have set.
verse: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
note: Boundary stones marked family land; moving one at night was quiet theft of a neighbor's inheritance.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and _____ my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verse: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
note: Keep my sabbaths, 'reverence' my sanctuary — holy time and holy space, repeated word for word in Leviticus 26:2.
